caption: The video captures a close, high-angle, steady view of a white ceramic bowl with a wide rim, filled with vivid blue liquid. A pale blue patch rests in the lower-left area of the liquid surface, with a darker shadow just to its right and near the front edge. The patch drifts slowly downward and slightly leftward within the blue liquid relative to the bowl rim across the excerpt. As it moves, its outline becomes less elongated and more compact, while the adjacent shadow stays beside it and follows the same path. The bright rim of the bowl and the softly blurred dark background remain largely fixed in the frame. No large splash, ripple, or obvious disturbance spreads across the blue liquid during the visible portion. The overall motion appears small and continuous rather than a sudden change in the scene. The patch remains visible within the bowl throughout the excerpt, with its position and shape changing only gradually.
